This file is for doing data import. 


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import two datasets
Import our first dataset

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read.csv(file = "data/FAS_litters.csv")

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import our second dataset
```{r}
pups_df =
  read.csv(file = "data/FAS_pups.csv", skip = 3) # skip 3 rows because the csv has the data codebook on the first few rows

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

## Look at the data
```{r}
# litters_df
# pups_df
```

Head or tail
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)
tail(pups_df, 5)
```

Skimming??

```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df) # prints an extended summary of what's going on
```
